description.content: Fallbacks that work with no peer: the person who did it by hand records it here. Edit the labels to propose better ones; add a row to offer a fallback for another kind of requirement.
Set the items aside by hand

Implement the requested work using the updated project notes and tasks. Read fos_read and fos_outstanding before starting and after each item. Run relevant checks, commit changes, push HEAD to the requested branch on origin, and open or reuse a GitHub PR targeting {{main-branch}} in {{repository}}. Never merge it. Record the PR URL and test results in a Fos proposal.

Verify the deployed project at {{deployment-url}} using the Chrome connector. Check its notes and tasks against the deployed commit. Record steps, URLs, observations, and pass/fail/blocked for every check. Missing tools or access are blocked, never a pass. Do not change implementation.
Implement the branch from its notes and tasks; open a PR for review
